records.title: VRSA: Jailbreaking Multimodal Large Language Models Through Visual Reasoning Sequential Attack
records.reason: VRSA proposes a visual jailbreak attack against multimodal LLMs and evaluates attack success; it does not address inference efficiency.

records.title: On-Policy RL Meets Off-Policy Experts: Harmonizing Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning via Dynamic Weighting
records.reason: CHORD changes the balance of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning during post-training; its contribution is training stability/capability, not inference-time efficiency.

records.title: Into the ORBIT for Time Series: Training Regimes for Foundation Models
records.reason: ORBIT studies time-series foundation-model training regimes and forecasting. Its training objective is noted as adding no inference cost, but it does not propose an inference optimization or target LLM serving.

records.title: Covert Influence Between Language Models
records.reason: The paper studies covert influence and attribution across training/distillation/in-context interfaces; it is a security-risk analysis, not an efficiency contribution.

records.title: Workspace Optimization: How to Train Your Agent
records.reason: Workspace optimization reports 31% fewer environment actions for an agent harness, but this measures task interaction steps rather than model tokens, latency, compute, memory, or serving throughput; keep borderline because the agent-system connection is indirect.

records.title: Detection of submarine pipeline and cable targets based on depth feature of high resolution sonar image
records.reason: The PLOS title identifies sonar-image detection of submarine pipelines/cables, a distinct non-LLM application. Only the title was needed to establish the subject mismatch; PLOS full text discusses lightweight YOLO for this sonar task, not LLM inference.

records.title: A Review of Federated Large Language Models for Industry 4.0
records.reason: The official MDPI article reviews federated LLM systems for Industry 4.0 and discusses computation/communication overhead, edge constraints, and deployment strategies. It is relevant systems context, but as a survey it does not establish a specific new efficiency method or measured inference improvement.

records.title: VI-OCR: “Visually Impaired” optical character recognition pipeline for text accessibility assessment
records.reason: The Nature abstract evaluates OCR/VLM ability to mimic low-vision text recognition for accessibility assessment; this is a specialized application and does not contribute LLM inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Benchmarking Document Parsers on Mathematical Formula Extraction from PDFs
records.reason: The primary abstract benchmarks PDF formula parsers for semantic extraction quality. It provides a document-processing benchmark, not an LLM runtime/serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: InnoGym: Benchmarking the Innovation Potential of AI Agents
records.reason: InnoGym benchmarks the novelty and performance of agent solutions; it evaluates innovation and task outcomes rather than inference execution cost or system efficiency.
